title: Creeper Fx (Alx)
description: Your Creepers will never sound the same, This is my first mod ever created :)
body: Creeper FX (Alx) is a lightweight cosmetic mod that replaces the creeper's original explosion sound with custom sounds, while maintaining the original gameplay since these sounds are unique to the creeper. Most of the sounds are so random that they're actually kind of funny. This is my first mod, and it works well in both single-player and multiplayer modes. I was thinking of adding even more features, but I don't have a clear idea yet. Any recommendations or ideas are welcome :)
